mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near the Verona Area High School, and we are currently in the First Quarter moon phase. Keep your eyes on the sky tonight at 5:44 PM for a 5-minute ISS flyover, moving from the Mount Horeb area toward the Madison side of town.

The City of Verona has released important notices regarding the November 2026 general election, including information on polling locations and facility audits. Additionally, residents can check the latest recreational league power standings online via the city website.
We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run today, followed by more tunes at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Also, don't miss yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
On October 25, Verona police officers conducted a welfare check at an intersection, which resulted in the arrest of a 40-year-old man for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by to enjoy their featured flavor of the day, Mint Explosion.
